reena: FYI we're doing a focused admin entitlement sweep in staging tomorrow 08:45 PT. Scope: stale admin roles, KMS grant sanity, and audit-log replay.
mike: Thanks. Which services are the canary and what's the abort criteria?
reena: Canary: api-gateway, user-sync. Abort if >=1% 401s for either service or if audit replay misses any kms grant ops.
ops-bot: preflight snapshot created: snap-4201239999. artifact: s3://sec-dryruns/snap-4201239999.tar.gz
reena: KMS commands (staging):
```
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/stg-main --grant-id a1b2c3d4
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/stg-main --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/stg-role --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```
sre-liaison: i'll monitor token refresh errors and pod restarts. alert if token err rate >0.5% or restarts >3/5m.
audit-bot: playback window captured. searching CloudTrail for RevokeGrant/CreateGrant/RetireGrant for alias/stg-main.
reena: Canary done: api-gateway saw one transient 401 during revoke window, fixed after re-create and restart. audit-bot confirms both RevokeGrant and CreateGrant present. No missing events.
mike: OK — please draft a short blameless note for support and schedule staggered prod windows (20m). Also add exclusion for keys with external grantees.
reena: Will open RFC-SEC-453 and attach logs. Thanks everyone.
